en: The postcard features a black and white panoramic view of a European town with classical architecture, wide streets, and tree-lined avenues against a hilly backdrop. The caption at the bottom reads 'St. Zagora. Gesamtansicht', indicating a general view of Stara Zagora. The back of the postcard has handwritten text, postal stamps, and a green stamp from Bulgaria dated 1940, with images of people in traditional attire and a portrait. The writing is mostly in Italian and Cyrillic, and there are date marks from 1950.
